title: candidate_shot.v0
description: DRAFT. Candidate Shot record for Shot Intelligence. A Candidate Shot keeps only what changes an editing decision. This is a draft contract with NO extraction implementation: nothing in this repository currently produces one from media.

editing_facts.description: Only facts that can change shot selection, ordering, or cut timing. Facts with no demonstrated editing consequence do not belong here.

narrative_beat_evidence.description: Which narrative beats this shot can supply visual evidence for. Material Gap is measured as narrative beat evidence coverage, never as clip count.

candidate_boundary_frame.description: A Candidate Boundary is NOT a Timeline Boundary. It is evidence for a cut, not approval of one.

x-implementation-status.analysis_stage: Rough Scan -> editing-relevant Candidate Analysis -> Fine Analysis on the narrowed set
